''TLI Loglan'' - the original version of Loglan, which many of us feel to be inferior to [[Lojban|Lojban]], is still available. Go to [http://www.loglan.org/ http://www.loglan.org/].

There is also [https://mailman.ucsd.edu/mailman/listinfo/loglanists the ''Loglanists'' mailing list] (archived only from 2013 on).

[[The Logical Language Group]] claims that the word ''Loglan'' is generic, and applies to [[Lojban]] as well. It was vindicated after a drawn-out legal process. Because the Loglan effort was coordinated by [[The Loglan Institute|The Loglan Institute]], one will also see the older variant of the language called ''Institute Loglan''.
